notes: Mid-market SaaS building multi-tenant agent product for customer support and guided workflows.
Primary concerns: streaming stability under concurrent connections, tool calling reliability (webhook timeouts), and per-tenant quotas/rate-limiting.
Latency SLO: want p95 streaming start < 250ms and per-token generation latency consistent for interactive sessions.
Throughput targets: 3 tenants in initial POC, goal to scale to ~50 tenants in first 12 months; expect bursty traffic 50-200 RPS across cluster.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, short-term willing to pay hosted overage for fast time-to-market but will move to Dedicated for predictable unit costs.
Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated models; prefer ability to route by latency/cost and fallback to 8-bit quantized variant for cold starts.
Deployment: start on Hosted API for POC, Dedicated reserved capacity discussion pending if POC meets latency and streaming stability.
Security: must have SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration; data residency preference: US-east for HQ.
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-05: 'Need stable streaming - it's core to our UX. If streaming drops under 5% error at scale we can't ship.'
SE notes: plan to test continuous streaming connections + simulated tool-calls with 500ms external webhook latency to validate retries and backpressure handling.
POC success criteria: p95 streaming start <250ms, error rate <2% under defined load, per-tenant quotas enforceable and observable via Console, token-level cost breakdown in analytics.
Customer expects a short pricing term for Dedicated (6-12 month commit) if unit economics and SLOs are met.
Next steps: kickoff POC (hosted), load tests scheduled, share security FAQ and Dedicated pricing sheet (drive link above).
